paragraphs.text: Shi'ar is a creature type depicting an avian -like humanoid extraterrestrial species . It was introduced in Universes Beyond Marvel Super Heroes .

Shi'ar is a Marvel Universes Beyond crossover type. They are a species of avian -like humanoid aliens originally from the planet Chandilar within a galaxy named after them. They are the dominant species in their galaxy subjugating all worlds in it under their empire. They are known to be both technologically advanced and extremely militaristic. The Shi’ar most often resemble humans but with feathered crests atop their heads in place of hair. They are both more durable and stronger than the average human.
